protocol.scope: Two-axis offline translation grid, followed only for a qualified selection by a separate no-cut fixture preflight. No existing scene or controller changes.
protocol.mapping: Use the shared midpoint of frozen material row 5 in RCM beam coordinates as the reference. A grid point translates the entire fixture by the yaw- and pitch-transverse differences from adding the requested angles to the two reference rays, with axial coordinate and sheet orientation unchanged.
protocol.geometry: Reuse sealed v1 wrist geometry, intercept, soft joint limits, 15 positions per view, all three fixed observed blade rotations per view, and the seven nominal/axis perturbations. Both views must pass on all samples. Select the lowest translation norm, breaking ties by ascending grid indices. A candidate with zero pitch shift must not be deployed. No inference about scene reachability from the model.
protocol.runtime: For the sealed selected two-axis candidate only, run on a fresh verified scene. Preserve stock normal collision guards, do not open, close, or cut with the cutter, and stop on a refused step. Verify stock arm roles/homing, two actual grasps under load, full guarded cutter IK on the translated 0--10 mm route, native same-frame sheet and marker visibility at registered ECM work poses, and closed guarded return. Labels and mechanical readbacks are diagnostics only; no benchmark evidence.
